 Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023: India’s DPDP Act addresses the collection, processing, and storage of digital personal data. Advertisement [...] One is a data bottleneck. Enterprises need to have trustworthy data that is fresh, accurate, and connected, made available to the agent. High technology costs and difficulty in proving returns still block wider AI integration for many Indian SMBs. Only 26% of enterprises have operationalized AI at scale, according to Forrester's 2026 research, suggesting many struggle to move beyond initial experiments.

## Practical Strategies for India AI Adoption for SMBs [...] ### Data Readiness and Fragmentation

Many enterprises, including SMBs, struggle with data readiness. Customer and transaction data often reside across various platforms, such as Salesforce, SAP, and even independent spreadsheets. These sources frequently lack consistent field names, requiring extensive schema reconciliation before AI models can be trained. Poor data quality, fragmented data, and a lack of clear governance ownership are common barriers. Approximately half of Indian businesses still rely on spreadsheets and WhatsApp, indicating a low level of digital maturity that hinders effective data preparation for AI.
